name: compaction-suggy-monorepo
description: Compaction Suggy — topic-shift detection & compaction advisor for ChatGPT Web, Claude.ai Web, Claude Code (Hooks & Mods), Claude Desktop (Code/Cowork), and OpenAI Codex (CLI/Desktop/IDE) powered by Decision Model APIs.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli-hook packages/claude-mod && tsc -p packages/browser-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli-hook packages/claude-mod && tsc -p packages/browser-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.pack:npm: npm run build && mkdir -p release && npm pack --workspace=compaction-suggy --pack-destination=release
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm publish --workspace=compaction-suggy --access public
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/cli-hook/test/*.test.ts packages/claude-mod/test/*.test.ts packages/browser-extension/test/*.test.ts
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/core/dist packages/cli-hook/dist packages/claude-mod/dist packages/browser-extension/dist packages/compaction-suggy/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo plugins/compaction-suggy/dist plugins/compaction-suggy-mod/dist release
